data_section_full_text:
We construct our sample using conference call transcripts from Thomson Reuters


StreetEvents, analyst and management forecasts from I/B/E/S, and stock returns and accounting


items from CRSP and Compustat. We begin the sample in 2002, when conference call transcripts are


first available from StreetEvents, and conclude in 2011. The sample consists of 60,172 firm-quarters


with conference call transcripts and the necessary CRSP, Compustat, and I/B/E/S data.
